scope: Read-only timing/launch boundary audit; no benchmark and no performance claim

findings.fact: initialization_ms covers module image validation/load and cache lookup; Cuda context construction occurs elsewhere.
elapsed_ms includes Python input packing, allocations, uploads, kernel launch/synchronization, readback and query-list formatting. It is not a device-only kernel measurement.
Buffer release in finally occurs after elapsed_ms is calculated and is excluded.
Each run allocates its workspace and all input/output buffers. Launch is one thread/block per squad; context/module reuse does not imply buffer reuse.
Kernel index already uses blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x with id >= n guard. The old warp32 fault must not be attributed to an unverified missing thread index.
CUDA stack limit is set to 131072 each run. Function local-memory/stack attributes and launch restrictions need measurement before any launch-geometry experiment.

next_measurement: After full regression and checkpoint, measure preparation, allocation, host-to-device, kernel device time, device-to-host, result formatting and cleanup separately. Include complete request wall time.
